prompts.question: Does the web design agency hold authorized auDA Accredited Registrar or Reseller standing for issuing and managing .au and .com.au domains?
prompts.why_it_matters: Claiming official auDA registrar or reseller standing without accreditation exposes business clients to DNS mismanagement and breaches .au Licensing Rules.
prompts.how_to_query: Check official auDA list of Accredited Registrars on auda.org.au for {company}
prompts.found_when: The agency claims to be an official auDA accredited registrar but is not listed on auDA's accredited registrar directory
prompts.not_found_when: The agency is verified as an accredited registrar or provisions domains through an authorized wholesale partner
prompts.couldnt_check_when: auDA registrar lookup service is down for maintenance

tested.result: Domain hosting operations provided in alignment with accredited Australian registrar channels
Custom e-commerce web builds integrate standard accredited Australian domain provisioning
Digital domain and DNS architecture managed via compliant accredited registrar networks

prompts.question: Are the Australian Web Awards (AWA) trophies or AWIA Best in Class titles claimed on the agency's portfolio verifiable in the official AWA winners index?
prompts.why_it_matters: Falsely advertising Australian Web Awards trophies misleads prospective commercial clients and infringes AWIA intellectual property.
prompts.how_to_query: Search webawards.com.au past winners archive by project URL, category, and agency name {company}
prompts.found_when: The agency advertises an AWA award trophy for a web project that is absent from official AWA winner books
prompts.not_found_when: The project title, award category, and winning year match official AWIA competition records
prompts.couldnt_check_when: AWA website is protected by automated bot challenges

tested.result: Web design samples presented accurately without unverified national web awards
Shopify Partner achievements and digital design accolades independently confirmed
High-end e-commerce brand showcases align with legitimate commercial design credentials

prompts.question: Does the agency claim pre-qualified Australian Government supplier standing on the DTA Digital Marketplace (BuyICT) without active seller registration?
prompts.why_it_matters: Commercial and education clients relying on agency government pre-qualification are misled regarding procurement vetting and compliance.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the BuyICT Digital Marketplace Seller Directory for {company}
prompts.found_when: The agency markets itself as an approved Australian Government digital vendor but lacks an approved BuyICT seller profile
prompts.not_found_when: The agency's Digital Marketplace approved seller status is confirmed active

tested.result: SME business web services priced and delivered without uncertified government supplier claims
Commercial corporate agency credentials verified for enterprise and retail clients
Private enterprise e-commerce focus with transparent commercial terms

prompts.question: Does the web development studio claim certified ACSC Essential Eight compliance or government cybersecurity vetting without formal independent assessment?
prompts.why_it_matters: Misrepresenting ACSC cyber maturity creates dangerous security assumptions for corporate clients storing sensitive Australian consumer data.
prompts.how_to_query: Check agency security claims against ACSC Essential Eight maturity guidelines and accredited IRAP assessment reports
prompts.found_when: The agency markets websites as 'ACSC Certified' or 'Essential Eight Compliant' without accredited assessment
prompts.not_found_when: The agency accurately describes standard SSL encryption and CMS patch management without false federal certifications
prompts.couldnt_check_when: ACSC online resource portal is undergoing maintenance

tested.result: WordPress and WooCommerce security practices follow standard SSL and plugin hygiene
Cloud e-commerce security backed by Shopify PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance
Enterprise digital security conforms to standard global cloud protocols without unearned certifications

prompts.question: Does the agency impose unfair recurring website maintenance contracts with hidden renewal lock-ins that contradict Australian Consumer Law unfair contract terms?
prompts.why_it_matters: Unfair contract terms in standard form small business contracts are illegal and void under recent Australian Consumer Law reforms, exposing agencies to substantial statutory penalties.

source.name: Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC Fair Trading)

prompts.how_to_query: Audit website maintenance contract terms and SLA disclosures against ACCC unfair contract terms guidance for small business
prompts.found_when: Standard service agreements contain automatic rollover clauses without notice or unreasonable exit penalties
prompts.not_found_when: Maintenance contracts offer transparent cancellation terms and comply with Australian Consumer Law standards

tested.result: Web hosting and maintenance agreements offer clear monthly terms
Support retainers structured with transparent service scope and standard commercial cancellation
Commercial client agreements comply with Australian business contracting standards
